summary: Re-tested Project Matrix app after E1's fixes. All 16 backend pytest cases PASS (including previously-failing TestDashboardStats). Full frontend flow verified end-to-end via Playwright: login (admin@projectmatrix.com/Admin@123) -> dashboard loads with stats card -> Team CRUD via sidebar drawer (create+delete) -> Project CRUD (create+edit+delete) -> view toggles Table<->Timeline. NO error toasts observed during any flow. Both previously-reported CRITICAL/HIGH bugs are FIXED: (1) /api/dashboard/stats no longer returns 500 on YYYY-MM-DD start_date (timezone.utc coerced when parsed datetime is naive), (2) Frontend dashboard renders projects/teams/stats correctly after creation (implicitly resolved because stats no longer 500s).

minor.issue: Malformed ObjectId still raises bson.errors.InvalidId => 500 instead of 400/404. Not blocking, but should be wrapped in try/except.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting (playbook standard is 5-fail lockout).
Still uses Promise.all; a single failing endpoint would blank projects/teams. Consider Promise.allSettled for defense-in-depth.

issues: Uses native <input type='date'> (browser default picker) instead of shadcn calendar component. Cosmetic only; date payload works correctly with backend after timezone fix.

action_items: LOW: Wrap ObjectId(...) parses with try/except -> 404 for invalid ids on /api/teams/{id} and /api/projects/{id}.
LOW: Add min-length password validation on /api/auth/register.
LOW: Consider brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (5 failed attempts).
LOW: Switch DashboardPage.fetchData to Promise.allSettled for defensive rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_dashboard_stats: timezone-aware coercion is now correctly applied when naive datetimes are parsed. Fix verified via pytest (test_stats_calculation_on_track_vs_lagging).
server.py access token TTL raised to 7 days aligned with refresh token — resolves the 401 on /api/teams after few minutes of inactivity as reported by E1.
server.py cookies use samesite='none'+secure=True with allow_credentials=True and explicit FRONTEND_URL origin — correct for cross-origin cookie flow. Good.
Remaining minor items are all LOW priority hardening, not blockers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, team CRUD, project CRUD, view toggles all working, no error toasts)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@projectmatrix.com / Admin@123 (verified from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, auto-seeded on startup, login works, cookies set as httpOnly samesite=none secure).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Created + cleaned up UITEST_/TEST_ projects and teams during testing. One pre-existing team 'Equipe A' may still be in DB from prior iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both reported bugs (dashboard 500 timezone + team creation 401) are FIXED. Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs green under pytest-xdist (16/16 in ~4s). Frontend Playwright covered: login->stats->TeamDrawer create/delete->ProjectDrawer create/edit/delete->view toggles. If further hardening is desired, tackle the 4 LOW items above (invalid ObjectId 500, password validation, login lockout, Promise.allSettled).
rca of the issue: Previously reported RCA (naive vs aware datetime in get_dashboard_stats) is now FIXED. server.py lines ~414-416 now do: `if start_date.tzinfo is None: start_date = start_date.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` before subtracting from `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`. Access token TTL raised from 15min to 7 days in create_access_token() prevents the 401 that E1 observed when returning to /api/teams. Verified end-to-end: created project with YYYY-MM-DD start_date, GET /api/dashboard/stats returns 200 with correct on_track/lagging counts.
